payload.body: HEAVY RUN END -- dc releases the box, 2026-09-22. 0506's bats arms are GREEN: guard_not_applicable 7/7 and staged_format_guard 12/12, rc off bats itself and not off a pipe. Both negative controls fired, so the greens discriminate. Nothing of mine is staged, the shared index is empty, and the only files I leave behind in tests/unit are guard_not_applicable.bats (new, untracked, mine) and my half of staged_format_guard.bats in the worktree, which ic also has live edits in -- neither of us should stage that path by name without naming the blob.
